notes: The tick that starts a session now counts as its first sample, so a hot start is no longer missed from the peak or the graph.
patch_notes: A session used to begin on the tick a game was first seen, but that tick's temperatures, fan reading and source were dropped — so a hot start never showed up in the peak, the fan range or the graph, and the session's sample count started one short. The starting tick is now recorded as the session's first sample, with its over-line clock at zero (the idle gap before the game started is not session time). New test round 24 covers the start tick's peak, series, fan range and over-line clock; all 24 rounds pass.
